headlineRates.emptyDescription: Reply, interview and offer rates all count applications that have actually gone out. Move one out of Draft and this fills in.

pipeline.emptyDescription: Each application sits in one stage, and this shows how they are spread across them. Add one and the first slice appears.

recent.emptyDescription: Every position you track shows up here as you touch it, newest first.

searchHealth.title: What to work on next
searchHealth.intro: your figures against a typical search
searchHealth.sampleTitle: Only the typical ring is illustrative
searchHealth.emptyDescription: This weighs your replies, interviews, referrals and follow-ups against a typical search. It needs applications that have actually gone out.

sources.title: Where they came from
sources.emptyDescription: Each application records where you found it — a job board, a referral, the department page. This splits them once there are some.

offers.title: Offers, side by side
offers.caption: Your open offers, with the package as you typed it, a yearly reading of it, and the date each one has to be answered by
offers.noAmount: No amount could be read from the package
offers.ranked: The yearly figure is read from what you typed — hover one to see which words it came from.
offers.unranked: These are not ranked: the packages are in different currencies, and jojo has no exchange rate and makes no network call to find one.
offers.annualisedNote: * annualised at 12 months, 52 weeks or 2,080 hours, which is a convention rather than your contract.

sticky.placeholder: Jot a note to self… (Enter to stick it)
sticky.empty: Nothing stuck up yet. Notes stay here until you take them down, and any of them can become a reminder once it has a date.

frequency.title: When you applied
frequency.emptyDescription: This counts the applications you send, week by week, split by the kind of role. Add one and the first bar appears.
frequency.noDates_one: Your one application carries no date yet. One is stamped when you move a record to Submitted.
frequency.noDates_other: None of your {{count}} applications carries a date yet. One is stamped when you move a record to Submitted.

perPeriod.week: Applications sent per week, split by {{series}}
perPeriod.month: Applications sent per month, split by {{series}}
perPeriod.quarter: Applications sent per quarter, split by {{series}}

frequency.countingUndated_one: Counting {{inWindow}} of {{total}} applications — {{count}} has no date yet.
frequency.countingUndated_other: Counting {{inWindow}} of {{total}} applications — {{count}} have no date yet.
frequency.countingBoth: Counting {{inWindow}} of {{total}} applications — {{undated}} without a date yet, and {{earlier}} before {{first}}.

priority.title: Needs a decision
priority.completedDescription: It leaves the deck and this week — nothing is deleted.
priority.rescheduledDescription: Now due {{date}}, on the calendar and the week ahead.
priority.notConnected: Nothing is connected to this yet
priority.emptyDescription: Offers, applications that are overdue, the next hard deadline and your next interview surface here. None of them is outstanding.

firstSteps.title: First steps

application.title: Add an application
application.body: A position, its stage and its deadline. Everything else in jojo hangs off this record.

dated.title: Give something a date
dated.body: Deadlines, interviews and visits are one kind of record, so a date reaches this page, the calendar and the application at once.

reminder.title: Set a follow-up
reminder.body: A reminder is the same record with a nudge switched on. Once its date passes it is owed, and it stays here until you tick it off.

firstSteps.complete: All three are done. Anything you add from here reaches this page, the calendar and the application it belongs to.
firstSteps.intro: Each step opens the real thing and ticks itself once a record exists — none of it is a tutorial you have to sit through.
firstSteps.introBare: Nothing is tracked yet. Each step opens the real thing and ticks itself once a record exists — none of it is a tutorial you have to sit through.
firstSteps.hideHint: The same steps are written out in the guide

owed.title: Owed this week
owed.emptyDescription: Deadlines, interviews and follow-ups land here as soon as they have a date, and stay until you tick them off.

openAria.reminder: Open {{title}}: edit the reminder or go to its application
openAria.event: Open {{title}}: edit the event or go to its application

owed.completedDescription: It leaves this list and counts towards today — nothing is deleted.
owed.rescheduledDescription: Now due {{date}}, here and on the calendar.
